title: How He Makes 1% Per Week Selling Weekly Puts
summary: Josh Walker (soft-retired engineer, Prescott AZ) sells weekly cash-secured puts (~5 DTE, Monday to Friday) on a ~80-90 name tech watchlist, picking strikes just below discretionary Ichimoku Cloud / moving-average support levels and targeting 1.04% of account premium per week. The honest core: he volunteers that the '1% per week' is a premium-collection goal (~1.28% in 2025), while the realized account return was only ~0.9%/week (~30-40%/yr) once assigned losers he still held are counted, so the video title oversells by roughly 2x. Real, disciplined structure with correct capital-at-risk accounting (cash-secured, quoted on account value) and a sober 7/10 self-rated risk, but the win-determining edge is unfalsifiable chart-reading, there is no separable track record (self-reported, ~$50-60k account, one benign tech-bull year), and single-name tech CSPs carry a gap/assignment tail; the 'stock repair' overlay is really doubling down and he admits ~80% of rolls still get assigned. Write-up: strategies/weekly_put_selling.md (conviction 2/5).
